articles.title: SAP Confirms Security Incident as Hackers Reportedly Steal GitHub Tokens and Alter Code
articles.summary:
SAP has confirmed an IT security incident after detecting suspicious activity. DER SPIEGEL reported that attackers stole authentication tokens belonging to SAP employees and used them to alter and copy source code on GitHub. The German software maker said it took immediate steps to protect customers and secure its services. It said investigators had found […]

articles.title: Bitcoin Privacy Flaw Could Let Hackers Trace Wallet Addresses to IP Addresses for Just 35 Cents
articles.summary:
A privacy flaw in Bitcoin Core could let an observer link a public Bitcoin address to the IP address of a node that tracks it. Bitcoin Core contributor Abubakar Sadiq Ismail reported on November 25 that the link could be made with a payment costing less than 35 cents in his estimate. His test identified […]

articles.title: Node.js 27 Alpha Adds HTTP Security Protections and Deprecates TLS 1.2 Renegotiation
articles.summary:
The Node.js project released a version 27.0.0-alpha.0.2.0 on November 26, 2026, bringing security fixes for reused HTTP connections and new controls for TLS 1.2 renegotiation.
